title: Settings: Reset to 100% button for UI Size
description: The corner UI-size slider snaps to five stops (75, 93.75, 112.5, 131.25, 150%) that skip the 100% default, and the Settings slider is continuous, so once moved there was no exact way back. UI Size now shows a Reset to 100% button whenever the scale is off-default. Translated in all six shipped languages.
commit_message: Settings: add Reset to 100% to UI Size (the corner slider's stops skip 100%)
